verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is exposed at docs.openhands.dev/openapi.json, indicating a machine-readable API reference exists for the Agent Server's HTTP/WebSocket API, but there is no evidence of an interactive explorer UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc try-it-out) or runnable code examples embedded in docs. Missing for 10: interactive API console/UI, runnable/executable code samples, independent confirmation of an explorable reference experience.
